scripts.dev: npm run codegen && npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm:dev -w server" "npm:dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run codegen && npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.codegen: graphql-codegen --config codegen.ts && node scripts/normalize-generated.mjs && prettier --write client/src/api/generated.ts shared/src/generated/graphql.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run codegen && npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run codegen && npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
